elements.name: Maya
elements.features: Shoulder-length, center-parted dark brown hair with flipped ends; average build, no glasses or facial hair.

voice.instructions: Use a steady conversational pace, warm mid-high pitch and soft brightness, with a neutral American accent and an adult vocal character.
voice.descriptor: Mid-high pitch, steady conversational pace, neutral American accent, clear, warm timbre with a soft brightness.
voice.why: Coral’s warm, bright timbre closely matches Maya’s clear, gently luminous delivery.
voice.sample_text: My name is Maya. In Cedar Studio, warm lamplight falls across a walnut table.

elements.name: Leo
elements.features: Short, side-parted brown hair, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, no glasses, average build.

voice.instructions: Speak at a relaxed conversational pace in a warm mid-low register with light grain, neutral American colouring and an adult vocal character; keep the phrasing natural rather than lyrical.
voice.descriptor: Mid-low pitch, relaxed conversational pace, neutral American accent, warm timbre with a light grain.
voice.why: Ballad provides Leo’s warmth and mid-low pitch, with delivery guidance to keep it conversational.
voice.sample_text: My name is Leo. In Cedar Studio, warm lamplight falls across a walnut table.

voice.instructions: Deliver with measured, unhurried pacing, clear articulation and calm documentary restraint, using neutral American colouring and a mature adult vocal character.
